The **R-TimeSeriesAnalysis** folder provides R, Rmarkdown rsp. Quarto (RMD/qmd)  files for time series analysis. 

See corresponding subfolders `Climate` and `Corona-Virus`.

## R code

My own R package `pkgTS` for TimeSeries Functions 
is hosted on GitHub (https://github.com/WoVollmer/pkgTS) and can be downloaded  using the following command:

`pak::pak("WoVollmer/pkgTS")` 

`library(pkgTS)`
